title: Clover Undertow
description: A five-quarter bass figure repeatedly crosses the four-beat bar line. Above it, the F–E–D–C refrain from Clover Causeway opens into a long D-minor song. The ground darkens into C minor, returns, then gives way to broad chords and a bright D-major ending.
difficulty: Advanced displaced ostinato and long melodic arcs
technical_note: The LH figure lasts five quarter beats, returning every five bars after four cycles. Its dotted opening sometimes crosses a bar line. Keep the RH song free from the shifting bass accents. Broaden the final five bars without losing the full sound.

performance.note: The five-beat ground creates its own gentle displacement. Let the melody keep a broad direction across it; the final D-major chords retain warmth and definition.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
